rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L62 "Do the linked Module 2 prework first." (chunk 9 "Bring to Module 2") is the closest: the link sits on the next slide (L68), but "Module 2 prework" is named in the same sentence, so the referent resolves; harm (an unresolvable pointer) absent. Session artifacts (L32 rules file, context-trace.md, L48 the site) exempt by the exercise-session carve-out and module include order; L52 "the critic" resolves to L48's cold critic.

L22 "Read the opening, Context is King, then do the exercise, Paint by agent with guardrails." names each file by title, not position; L70 "the prework" names a real document. No positional callback to another file.

rules_evaluated.evidence: Resolved by ls from curriculum/: exercises/personal-site-with-guardrails.md, lectures/{context-is-king,what-just-happened,module-2-prework}.md exist; grep -c 'context-trace' in the exercise = 1, 'personal-brand-generation' = 3, 'site.html' = 3. rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess-before-reveal beat in the body; the old guess cue was removed. Closest: L48-52 cold-critic slide, where the prompt is followed by the interpretation with no outcome narrated before it. Muted read: every chunk opens with a verbed sentence (L48 "Ask the agent to open a second, independent reader"); no verbless scene-setter and no terminal-aimed cue.

Closest: chunk 9 "Bring to Module 2" L62 "Bring a live challenge. Do the linked Module 2 prework first." carries a claim and an action on its own; chunk 11 "Next" L73 states carry and next job. No wait-state slides.

Closest: chunk 10 "Pre-reads before Module 2" (L64-70) ends with L70 housekeeping ("Save the prework, end this session...") that is not a pre-read; the header does not contradict the chunk, so it still reads as a true summary of its leads (optional reading + prework link).

Per chunk: no 'Not X. Not Y. Z.'; L4 "your profile, your rules, your judgement" is a concrete noun list, not an empty-leg triplet; L32 "what worked, what fell flat, what to keep, what to drop" enumerates the set the prompt sorts; no self-grading superlative (grep 'most useful|best|one of the most' in body = 0 by read); no number + retraction; no abstraction-noun stack; L44 chain is a concrete loop. Sub-items all clear.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body greps for dialect terms (compendium, forcing function, writing surface, firing, beat, mood) = 0 by read; canonical section names Big Idea, Debrief, Key Concepts are architecture-mandated; 'retro', 'cold critic', 'guardrails' are engineer-room vocabulary. 'Red thread' appears only in the maintainer block.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L48 "**Then, use a cold critic.**" bolds a whole 5-word lead sentence, but it is the only bold on its slide, so the monoculture harm (every bullet a bolded sentence) is absent; L20 bolded label "The question, to you:" is one handle. L14-16 three bolded LO verbs are exempt (template-mandated). Sibling test: no sibling slide disagrees. Suggestion filed to narrow L48.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: body_view signals slide_count=11 equals the 11 `##` headings in the module file (Big Idea..Next), which a top-level section.module projects into the deck; no deck-shaped or chunking edit in the diff since 19381896 (no `##` text changed: git diff | grep '^[-+]#' shows only a Start-here position artefact). Both-layout render was not run by me; mechanical claim limited to the count.

rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L55-58 Key Concepts restates L4 Big Idea ("Context is the brush: what you give the agent shapes the output."), a doctrine restatement shape, but the maintainer block attests it (2026-09-24 Key Concepts minimal glance list; 2026-11-13 Red thread: align existing lines, say it in different ways). L52 "Your read outweighs the agent's." adds a priority, not a kicker; L44 "Repeat on every rules file." adds a move.
